suggested_fix.fix_text: The Planner's analysis in Turn 3 explicitly claims the WebSurfer result states Mborja was Secretary of the 'Albanian Fascist Party'. This is a critical hallucination. Historical fact confirms Tefik Selim Mborja was a prominent member of the Communist Party of Albania (Partia e Punës e Shqipërisë), specifically serving as its General Secretary from 1966 until the party dissolved in 1991. The 'Albanian Fascist Party' (Balli Kombëtar or similar fascist groups) did not have Mborja as leadership, nor did they hold power until 1944. The Planner should have recognized the initial search snippet was likely misread or the model hallucinated the political affiliation, causing a complete failure to answer the question correctly (which requires the year 1991, not 1944). The error type is severe hallucination leading to factual mismatch.
